name: Voice-controlled Frotz player for Infocom adventures

mentions.name: Voice-controlled Frotz player for Infocom adventures
mentions.description: A version of the Infocom adventure Frotz player adapted to work with voice control on the AI ball, so games like Planetfall can be played by voice.
